steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Create the base directory tree and workspace for Mind Grid Game.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Set up app/build.gradle with Java 17 and Android SDK 34 compatibility configurations.

steps.title: Establish App Manifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with the required launch permissions, portrait orientation lock, and package attributes.

steps.title: Define Application Resources
steps.description: Implement essential values, text string arrays, and custom modern color maps inside resource files.

steps.title: Construct Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Design an interactive UI featuring dual gamemode buttons, scores dashboard, prompt banner, and an dynamic auto-scaling grid.

steps.title: Implement Tone Sound System
steps.description: Integrate Native ToneGenerator audio logic inside MainActivity to produce responsive, real-time auditory game state alerts.

steps.title: Implement Dynamic Grid Controller
steps.description: Program custom-styled rounded grid tiles dynamically calculated and rendered for flawless fit on any screen.

steps.title: Develop Sequence Recall Mode
steps.description: Program the custom sequential tile flasher logic requiring exact, chronologically correct user feedback inputs.

steps.title: Develop Matrix Memory Mode
steps.description: Implement spatial logic displaying static target clusters simultaneously to stretch standard visual retention capacities.

steps.title: Integrate Game Loop and State Controllers
steps.description: Develop game progression phases, sequence generators, level scaling, and input validation security filters.

steps.title: Configure High Score Local Storage
steps.description: Code persistent SharedPreferences features to record personal high score performance across all modes locally.

steps.title: Building Mind Grid Game
steps.description: Compile, build, and sign the application package in the development workspace environment.
